findings.title: Test product literal lacks required `active`, failing the type check
findings.why: `priceOrder` takes `LineInput.product: Product`, and `Product` requires `active: boolean` (src/catalog.ts). The literal at line 25 has no `active`. tsconfig is strict and includes `test`, so a `tsc` type check fails even though `node --test` strips types and still runs.

findings.title: Spec says the shipping threshold is already fixed, but this change fixes it
findings.why: Report 2 says it was 'already fixed in d2f9555' with 'no code change'. That commit is not in the repository, and this same change edits `src/shipping.ts` from `>` to `>=`. Spec 001 also lists the shipping fix as part of this work, so the three spec files contradict each other.
